title: Anticancer Effect of Pinostrobin on Human Breast Cancer Cells Through Regulation of Epithelial Mesenchymal Transition.
authors: Jongjang, Pimrapat; Likitnukul, Sutharinee; Reabroi, Somrudee; Mangmool, Supachoke; Nutho, Bodee; Pinthong, Darawan
one_liner_zh: 研究黄酮类化合物松属素对乳腺癌细胞EMT的抑制作用，仅涉及小分子-蛋白对接，无蛋白质-DNA互作或TF-DNA结合建模，与本课题无关。
abstract: Triple-negative breast cancer (TNBC) is the most aggressive type of breast cancer, with a high incidence of metastasis and chemoresistance. Epithelial-mesenchymal transition (EMT) is one of the molecular mechanisms that has been linked to the promotion of metastasis, and it can be promoted by several activators including the NF-kappaB signaling pathway. As a result, targeting EMT may be a potential strategy for treating TNBC. Pinostrobin is one of the important flavonoids found in the rhizome and rootlet of Boesenbergia rotunda (L.) Mansf. (fingerroot) that exhibits anticancer activities. However, the precise mechanism underlying the anticancer effect of pinostrobin on breast cancer remains unclear, and additional evidence is needed. In this study, the MCF-7 and MDA-MB-231 breast cancer cells were treated with various concentrations of pinostrobin. To determine the effect of pinostrobin on cell viability, an MTT assay was performed. Wound healing and Transwell chamber assays were conducted to examine the effect of pinostrobin on migration ability. RT-PCR was used to detect the expression of mRNA involved in NF-kappaB and EMT signaling pathways. The results revealed that low concentrations of pinostrobin did not affect cell viability, while higher concentrations produced an inhibitory effect on the viability of both cell lines. Pinostrobin also impeded migration and suppressed the expression of N-cadherin, a mesenchymal marker. Molecular docking analysis also suggested that the pinostrobin may target N-cadherin with higher binding affinity than IKK complex and NF-kappaB p65. These findings indicate that pinostrobin may serve as a potential treatment for TNBC.
abstract_zh: 三阴性乳腺癌（TNBC）是最具侵袭性的乳腺癌类型，具有高转移率和化疗耐药性。上皮-间质转化（EMT）是促进转移的分子机制之一，可由包括NF-kappaB信号通路在内的多种激活因子诱导。因此，靶向EMT可能是治疗TNBC的潜在策略。Pinostrobin是博森格利亚姜（Boesenbergia rotunda (L.) Mansf.，指根）根茎和须根中发现的重要黄酮类化合物之一，具有抗癌活性。然而，pinostrobin对乳腺癌抗癌作用的确切机制仍不清楚，需要更多证据支持。本研究以不同浓度的pinostrobin处理MCF-7和MDA-MB-231乳腺癌细胞。通过MTT实验测定pinostrobin对细胞活力的影响；采用伤口愈合和Transwell小室实验检测pinostrobin对迁移能力的作用；利用RT-PCR检测参与NF-kappaB和EMT信号通路的mRNA表达。结果显示，低浓度pinostrobin不影响细胞活力，而较高浓度对两种细胞系的活力均产生抑制作用。Pinostrobin还阻碍了细胞迁移，并抑制了间质标志物N-cadherin的表达。分子对接分析也提示，pinostrobin可能以比IKK复合物和NF-kappaB p65更高的结合亲和力靶向N-cadherin。这些发现表明，pinostrobin可能作为TNBC的潜在治疗药物。
